subject: Repackaging Monday demo into a focused hands-on pairing window
messages:
Date: 2027-05-18T15:12:00-07:00
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Subject: Proposal — swap Monday intro demo for a 90-min hands-on pairing window

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the time earlier — excited about the potential at Acme. I heard from your note that the execs will be traveling on Monday and that a short exec-focused demo won't get to the technical questions your engineering leads raised. Rather than a high-level intro, would you be open to converting Monday's 60-min slot into a 90-minute hands-on pairing session that focuses on:

- One end-to-end inference flow (Redwood Console → model variant → latency/cost profile)
- Live Q&A on network/VPC controls and audit logs
- Quick walk-through of suggested config for your 10k daily inference load

We can keep it small (2x Redwood engineers + your 3 engineers) and use a sandbox project so we can run short experiments during the session. If that sounds useful, I attached a short POC agenda and a two-item prework checklist so the session can start with real results.

Proposed times (PT):
- Monday 2027-05-24, 10:00–11:30
- Tuesday 2027-05-25, 09:00–10:30
- Wednesday 2027-05-26, 13:00–14:30

If none of these work we can also split into two 45-min blocks across teams. Quick ask: can you confirm who from your infra team can join, and whether the sandbox network allows outbound to api.redwood.com?

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachment: POC-Agenda-v2.pdf (agenda outline)
Attachment: prework-checklist.md (short network/prep steps)

Date: 2027-05-19T08:04:00-04:00
From: Emily Park <emily.park@acme.com>

Cc: Acme Platform Team <platform@acme.com>
Subject: Re: Proposal — swap Monday intro demo for a 90-min hands-on pairing window

Marissa —

Appreciate the thoughtful approach. Executive travel means the original audience can't make the high-level slot, but this technical pairing option sounds perfect for our infra and ML teams. A couple of constraints:

- Our infra lead will be traveling 5/24–5/25 (PST) so the Tuesday option won't work.
- We want to include a short procurement/contracting check-in with procurement — that can be a 15-min call later in the week; no need to mix it into the pairing session.

Can we aim for Wednesday 5/26 13:00–14:30 PT? That works for our ML lead (Samir) and infra (Lena). We might need to compress to 75 minutes because of a standing conflict for one of the engineers.

I'll confirm sandbox network access with Lena and get you the final attendee list by EOD tomorrow. Also — could you include a short snippet in the agenda about data residency options? That's a key procurement question.

—Emily
